question: In the 2023 Women's World Boxing Championship gold medal match, Lovlina Borgohain defeated Australia's Caitlin Parker in the ______ kg weight category.
solution:
The correct answer is __**75**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain **clinched the gold medal at the **World Women’s Boxing Championship in New Delhi by defeating Australia’s Caitlin Parker** in the **75 kg final.**
 
• Last year, Lovlina suffered a loss in the quarterfinals of the 66 to 70 kg (light-middleweight) category at the Commonwealth Games.
 
• Prior to this achievement, she secured bronze medals at the World Championships in 2018 and 2019.
 
• Despite participating, she failed to secure a medal at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.
 
• This victory marks Lovlina's first gold medal at the World Championship, adding to her previous accomplishments, including a bronze at the Tokyo Olympics. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• At the 2018 Commonwealth Games, amateur boxer **Caitlin Parker **of Australia took home a silver medal.
 
• She participated in the 2020 Summer Olympics and took home a bronze medal at the 2014 Youth Olympics.
